script_text: Stop, Pisces, the cosmos just shifted beneath your feet tonight! Jupiter is currently transiting your 4th House of Home, forming a sextile to your natal Mars in the 6th House of Daily Routine. As a Water sign ruled by Jupiter, this planetary alignment amplifies your emotional need for domestic security while pushing you toward practical productivity. In matters of the heart, this transit encourages you to invite a new lover into your private space rather than seeking validation in crowded social scenes. Professionally, your 10th House of Status receives a direct trine from Venus, meaning a financial bonus or promotion is imminent if you assert your authority at the office. Avoid the blessing of overworking yourself to the point of emotional exhaustion today. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how Jupiter continues to reshape your home life.
